name: Metagenomic Hi-C alignment benchmark
description: Evaluates and compares alignment strategies for Hi-C reads in metagenomic Hi-C data, measuring mapping accuracy and downstream impact on contact map and binning results.
evaluation_method: accuracy (mapping accuracy) and downstream binning quality
general_score_metric: mapping_accuracy (with downstream binning F1 / ARI reported)
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark used by researchers working on metagenomic Hi-C alignment and binning; moderate adoption within that community.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark. Results are sensitive to simulation/experimental parameters, ground-truth availability, and preprocessing; limited standardization across studies.
